gaps: NAIA before 2006: 2005 NAIA 'Ratings' pages exist on naia-archive, but their page dates are the dates pages were created, not release dates (e.g. the preseason rating was re-posted Sept. 12), so 2005 is omitted instead of guessing dates. No earlier NAIA polls were found online.
NAIA 2006 is the NAIA National Rating (Top 25), the voted national ranking that came before the Coaches' Top 25 (renamed in 2007). It is labeled as such in the poll field.

NAIA 2006-2010 release dates come from the release pages' dates, confirmed by 'announced today (Mon. D)' / weekday text where present. No NAIA ratings calendar was found for those years, and no postseason polls exist before 2011.

NAIA 2011-2025 release dates come from NAIA's published ratings calendars. Where the page date disagreed with the calendar (2011: some pages were created days early), the calendar plus the weekday in the text was used. Each poll's notes give details.
NAIA 2024-2025 polls were biweekly (8 per season). That is the full schedule, not a gap.
NAIA 2026: Preseason, Poll 1 and Poll 2 (through Sept. 16, 2026). The new naia.org tables print no points; receiving votes appear only on the women's Poll 2 release.

NAIA Men 2011 Poll 2 (2011-09-13): the archived release page (https://naia-archive.prestosports.com/sports/msoc/2011-12/releases/20110913g8plu) shows the same table as the following poll (Poll 3, 2011-09-20); the table was overwritten on the source page, so this week is not recoverable from NAIA and is omitted.

NAIA Men 2011 Poll 6 (2011-10-11): the archived release page (https://naia-archive.prestosports.com/sports/msoc/2011-12/releases/20111011sxab9) shows the same table as the following poll (Poll 7, 2011-10-18); the table was overwritten on the source page, so this week is not recoverable from NAIA and is omitted.

NCAA DII 2006-2011 and 2016-2018 come from OCR of the scanned official archive PDFs (names spell-corrected against other weeks; ocr_read keeps the raw OCR text). Spot checks against NCAA.com reprints agree except for naming style. Treat these as primary-source transcriptions, less exact than the text years (2012-2015 NSCAA HTML; 2019-2026 web/text).
NCAA DII before 2006 not included: archive PDFs exist back to 1996, but the 2001-2005 scans are multi-column and OCR could not separate polls reliably.
NCAA DII 2006: the archive PDF has no Sept. 12 poll and no November regular-season-final poll; those weeks are missing.
NCAA DII 2025: no preseason poll in the United Soccer Coaches archive (the zip starts with the Sept. 9 1st Poll); none found elsewhere.
NCAA DII 2026: through Poll 5 (Sept. 29, 2026). The live women's page shows no 2026 preseason poll.
NCAA DII spring 2021 (season '2020'): the 'Last Poll' of May 11, 2021 is marked postseason_final; the 2021 spring NCAA DII tournament dates were not checked.

Date corrections: men's 2020-21 Poll 4 (web page printed April 16, 2021, a Friday; the archive PDF prints April 20, 2021; April 20 used). Women's 2021 Poll 6 (web printed Oct. 7, 2021, but records run through Oct. 10; archive prints Oct. 12; Oct. 12 used). Men's 2024 archive PDFs for Polls 1-3 misprint the year as 2023; the web snapshots with 2024 dates were used.
OCR polls still flagged complete=false (a rank digit could not be confirmed, or a team row was missed): see each poll's notes.
NCAA DII men 2009: no postseason-final poll in the archive PDF.
NAIA men 2019: the postseason poll page is dated Dec. 11, 2019 (the calendar said Dec. 12); the page date was used.
